description: ADCOS Evidence object: a cryptographically attributable observation supporting a claim (spec/architecture.md §6.11). The evidence_type enum is the frozen §6.11 evidence-type list. A remote node's statement about another node is a claim by the reporter and is never automatically equivalent to a direct observation by the target (LOCK-008). Cryptographic protection and attestation mechanics are owned by later Work Items.

claim.description: Reference to the claim this evidence supports.

evidence_type.description: Evidence provenance type; the frozen §6.11 list.

observer.description: Identity reference of the observer/reporter; provenance is explicit so reported claims cannot silently become authoritative facts (LOCK-008).

title: ADCOS Evidence
